definition.title: Find community problem signals
definition.description: Find recent public conversations that describe a target audience's problem and prepare a sourced, human-reviewable opportunity report with answer-first response drafts.

target_audience.title: Target audience
target_audience.description: Who should be experiencing the problem? Be specific about roles, situations, or types of users.

problem_to_find.title: Problem to find
problem_to_find.description: Describe the concrete task, frustration, or unmet need to look for.

product_context.title: Product context
product_context.description: What the product does, who it helps, and relevant limitations. This context is not proof that the product fits a conversation.

communities.title: Communities or public sites
communities.description: Optional public forums, subreddits, or GitHub Discussions to prioritize. Search coverage is not guaranteed for every source.

geography.title: Geography
geography.description: Optional country or region relevant to the audience or problem.

recency_days.title: Maximum conversation age
recency_days.description: Only include conversations within this many days when a reliable date is available.

exclusions.title: Exclude
exclusions.description: Optional topics, sources, or types of conversation to leave out.

max_opportunities.title: Maximum opportunities
max_opportunities.description: Maximum number of conversations to include in the review report.
